text:
maya: quick sync 1: console Bulk Apply reported 100% success but router logs show several 409 etag rejects.
priya: yeah saw that too during tenant sweep. console aggregates batch success and hides per-item 409s. not ideal.
jonah: we should have a preflight that runs the same operator code as apply and returns per-tenant would_apply + server_etag. preview today uses a lighter evaluator and misses coalesce fast-path differences.
sasha: agree. propose two modes: quick-preview (existing, cheap) and full-simulate (runs operator path in read-only/shadow). full-simulate can be async and report via webhook.
maya: UI change: show per-flag per-tenant results and surface etag mismatches. block Bulk Apply until user acknowledges mismatches.
priya: telemetry needs fields: preflight_id, mode=quick|full, diff_hash, etag_mismatch=true|false. stable sample key = rollout_id+tenant_id.
jonah: ops concern: full-simulate is heavier. cap concurrent full-simulates per org and exempt shadow from burst quota but don't let it DOS infra.
sasha: API contract draft: POST /api/v1/config/preflight {rollout_id, flags[], mode}. returns 200 with quick-summary or 202 with job_id for full. GET /preflight/{job_id} returns list of {flag,tenant,would_change,server_etag,diff_hash}.
ops-bot: checklist: openapi change, operator read-only shim, console UX, rate-limits, telemetry schema. ticket INF-2467 created.
priya: timeline: api PR tomorrow, backend shim by EOW, console patch next week.
maya: +1. I'll prototype UI and heatmap for etag-drift.
